title: Accessibility, Mobile/Input, Performance & Nonblocking Fallbacks
objective: On a future governed start, define deterministic accessibility-equivalent controls, mobile/input adaptation, bounded performance behavior and explicit nonblocking fallback semantics over frozen MAL-01..08 without changing canonical game truth, owner-domain authority or deterministic outcomes.
selection_invariants: MAL-09 is selection only; no application mutation is authorized before governed start.
Accessibility alternatives must preserve semantic action equivalence and may not create easier or different canonical outcomes merely because an alternate control is used.

Mobile and device-specific raw inputs must be translated into frozen MAL-02 semantic inputs; raw device identity, refresh rate, frame timing, network timing and platform quirks never become game truth.
Performance strategies may reduce presentation detail or defer nonessential work but may not skip deterministic state transitions, owner handoffs, permission checks or canonical obligations.
Nonblocking fallbacks must be explicit, deterministic and visibility-conservative; unavailable or hidden owner state remains unresolved rather than guessed, auto-completed or silently substituted.
MAL-08 owner/reward boundaries remain frozen and no canonical owner mutation or reward grant is introduced.
AI remains proposal-only and cannot infer hidden state, commit owner outcomes or bypass accessibility/permission boundaries.
No durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
MAL-10 starter-library/golden-proof implementation, ALP-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: On owner-authorized continuation, perform the bounded MAL-09 governed-start tranche from exact application main 0df7fb35b22ae6906e876a1c651a6f7e00787a20 before any application mutation.
